test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Study the following Venn diagram and find the region representing persons who are writers, singers and dancers, but not actors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35c166fd108e5d33c30a27744c9b725931f35290d9cf5ef251acaecc5cf3618c.png]
solution:
• Region which is common to writers, singers and dancers = e + j

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c4be528ca2a8a7a3685e112524ef87595eb107a6effcee4a4abd84101e31990.png] 

 
• Region that includes writers, singers, and dancers, but not actors is :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f36cb96753a28bab96fed0629cbb03e07194d468c866b34953dd4365bcf33a9.png] 

Thus, region 'j' represents writers, singers and dancers but does not include actors.

Hence, **'option 3' **is the correct answer.
